exceptions.bounded_reason: Six source questions contain no hard label or hard template. The draft normalization profile introduces a new solution stage beyond the extracted graph-copy stages; no same-stage hard generator is validated. Public generation rejects hard.
exceptions.reopen_on: new source or same-method workload evidence

exceptions.bounded_reason: Duplicate field with missing correct ref; unrated missing key/solution; and two valid full-cover free-axis options respectively. Preserve all originals; exclude from strict available count.

distinctness: Dependent tasks: ordered base/dependent axes and exact coefficient; free tasks: requested coordinate only. Ignore seed, UUID, field/choice identity, bank profile, option order, function name, equation/argument order. Easy/moderate overlap is counted once across the selected pool.
